simple.meaning: צְלוּל (tsᵉlûwl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a (round or flattened) cake.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Judges 7:13. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.

occurrences.englishText: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”
